text:
michael: Heads up — noticed a jump in first-byte latency for /v1/chat.generate since last night's deploy. p50 up ~12ms on prod. cc @sara @raj

sara: saw this on the route dashboard. looks like first-byte (FTLT) moved up, generation latency mostly same. opened profiler on a canary pod.

raj: which model/variant is it spiking for? any obvious KV cache hitrate changes?

michael: mainly rdx-v2-7b-quant and rdx-v2-7b-4bit. KV hitrate appears stable from the logs, but we do get more cold-batch starts around the time window.

elaine: posted a short profiler extract from the canary run:
```
# top spans (ms)
selector_span: 1.2
fused_attention_kernel: 2.8
matmul_kernel: 12.4
decode_loop: 4.6
kv_lookup: 0.9
# note: many requests show matmul_kernel dominating first-byte time on canary
```

dong: my hunch: kernel selector flipped to a generic matmul path instead of the fused attn+matmul path. we changed a threshold in last week's selector PR that looks at avg_seq_len per route.

michael: is that PR #8425?

sara: yeah #8425 — it switched the selector to use `router_sample_count` to estimate avg_seq_len, not `request_count`. that makes the heuristic noisy when sampling rate varies.

raj: that explains it — noisy avg_seq_len -> selector picks lower-memory matmul kernel for some batches -> decode/kernel time up ~9-15ms on those requests. first-byte gets hit because the slower kernel is used early.

michael: proposal: add kernel-attribution panels to the per-route dashboard (fused-attn, matmul, kv-lookup), and separate first-byte vs streaming-decode times. also add a labeled metric for selector_decision(reason).

elaine: we should emit `kernel_choice` (labelled: fused_attn|matmul|fallback) and `kv_cache_state` (hit|miss|partial) per request so we can correlate. low overhead tagging only.

infra-bot: deploybot: rolling deploy rdx-runtime v1.23.1 started by @sara at 1762345680

dong: I can add a tracing span around the selector and emit `kernel_choice` counter. span adds ~1ms overhead in local bench. will open tiny PR.

sara: also recommend adding an alert: p50(first_byte) for route=chat.generate > 30ms for 15m -> notify eng-runtime on-call. keep 5m for dashboard spikes only.

raj: SG. prefer pager after 15m sustained to avoid noisy sampling blips.

michael: action items:
- dong: PR to instrument selector span + kernel_choice + kv_state (ETA: today)
- elaine: add prom metrics + new Grafana panel template for kernel attribution and per-route FTLT vs decode (ETA: tomorrow)
- sara: hold canary / consider rolling back selector tweak if PR doesn't improve metric (watch canary)
I'll update the runbook with selector troubleshooting steps.

elaine: draft PromQL snippets for the panel:
```
# avg kernel time per kernel type over 5m
avg by(kernel) (rate(runtime_kernel_time_seconds_sum[5m]) / rate(runtime_kernel_time_seconds_count[5m]))

# p50 first_byte for a route
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(first_byte_bucket{route="/v1/chat.generate"}[5m])) by (le))
```

michael: thanks — this should make root-cause much faster. ping me when metrics land. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploybot: canary rdx-runtime v1.23.1 finished at 1762345692 - 2/2 canaries healthy

dong: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/rdx-runtime/pull/8472 — adds selector span, `runtime_kernel_choice{kernel=...}` counter, and `runtime_kv_state` label. tests pass locally.

michael: great. once metrics ingest we wire the panel and close the loop. nice quick turnaround.
